policy.causal_rule: Do not convert co-occurrence, account ratios, dashboard open interest, company announcements or AI training events into XRP price causality without reconciled measurements and out-of-sample evidence.

nodes.label: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.

edges.claim: Liqwall reports about $1.41B open interest at 12:32 UTC, positive funding and long-skewed Binance account counts. Scope and methodology require reconciliation.
TradRadar reports about $2.00B open interest across seven exchanges at 13:00 UTC and a 78.8% long account share across five venues. Universe differs from Liqwall.
Coinperps reports $2.89B OI at 04:04 UTC and a 0.82 long/short account ratio. Its older cutoff and contrary account ratio make direct comparison invalid.

PR #1341 passed exact-head core CI and fail-closed gate. It scopes pull-requests:write to manual dispatch and makes matching push events read-only no-ops; it remains draft/unmerged and does not explain historical zero-job events.
PR #1338 has passing exact-head CI/gate and rejects malformed provider output, but remains draft/unmerged; main signal is unchanged.
PR #1340 has passing exact-head CI/gate but remains draft/unmerged. Main still serves stale mixed/positive narrative and audio reference.
The simulated position has position_product=null; no XRP or BTC identity should be assigned to the persisted position without an approved evidence-based reconciliation.
Tokyo SBIC East Japan's official materials document a generative-AI/ChatGPT training seminar. This does not establish an OpenAI partnership or any XRP relationship.
Coinbase Q3 results are scheduled after the US market close. Any effect on XRP would need event-window and confounder analysis; no result or price effect is inferred.
Circle Q3 results are scheduled for November 4. No XRP-specific causal link or unreleased result is inferred.

The main merge queue remains capable of mutating pull requests/branches; the paper trader separately can push state when manually dispatched. These are distinct workflow risks and should not be conflated.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The reported $1.41B, $2.00B and $2.89B XRP open-interest values primarily reflect different venue coverage, timestamps and aggregation methods rather than a single market state.
disconfirming_evidence: No normalized per-venue contract-level snapshot has been reconstructed.
The panels may overlap in venues, so the magnitude of scope effects remains unknown.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive funding and long-skewed account counts could indicate leveraged-long fragility, but the current evidence is insufficient for a directional XRP forecast.
disconfirming_evidence: Coinperps reports a contrary 0.82 account long/short ratio at a much older cutoff.
Account counts are not notional exposure.
Open interest may contain hedged positions and the dashboards are not synchronized.

competing_hypotheses.claim: A path-limited read-only push no-op may prevent a matching future push from being reported as a zero-job workflow run, but it does not identify the cause of prior historical anomalies.
disconfirming_evidence: The current main workflow declares workflow_dispatch only.
The reported historical push-event metadata and zero-job behavior have not been independently reconstructed from run payloads.
The added push trigger is limited to changes to the workflow file.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's Q3 disclosure may affect broad crypto risk appetite or expectations for stablecoin economics, with any XRP effect likely indirect unless XRP-specific exposure or flow data supports a direct channel.
disconfirming_evidence: Results were not yet due at this cutoff.
No event-window study or XRP-specific Coinbase flow attribution was performed.
Bitcoin, macro rates, liquidity and sector-wide conditions are confounders.
